messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — QBR for NimbusTech scheduled Fri May 23 11am PT. Need to assemble deck and run through exec asks + renewal signal. Who can own slides and action tracker?

Jared Ortiz: I can own slides for usage/health and onboarding progression. Will pull recent metrics.

Priya Rao: I'll cover infra/stability incidents and latency trends. Also check Dedicated capacity docs.

Leah Walker: I'll take the executive summary and renewal risk slide. Need a brief on blockers that could affect renewal.

Maya Chen: Awesome. Two asks: 1) capture onboarding completion % (CXM runbook) 2) list enablement items still pending (training, SSO, integrations). Use this template: https://redwood.internal/qbr-template (please copy to team folder).

Jared Ortiz: Quick note — onboarding: 78% completed, 3 customers in pilot stage (device sync failing), action item: eng-srv to triage by Wed. I'll add a small chart.

Priya Rao: Adding: incident on 5/12 (cache overflow) — mitigated; still seeing elevated KV cache misses for long-tail requests. Will include short remediation timeline.

Leah Walker: Renewal risk: Exec sponsor change + slow success milestones. Recommend 2-step: send exec summary pre-QBR and propose targeted enablement workshop. Will draft language.

Maya Chen: Can we get action owners + deadlines in the tracker? I added a sheet: /shared/nimbus-qbr/action-tracker. Deadline: Wed EOD for slides.

Jared Ortiz: ack, I'll upload slides by Wed noon. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: ack, aiming Wed 3pm. If I need earlier, I'll ping eng-runtime.

Leah Walker: I'll draft the exec note by Tue EOD for review.

Tom: Suggest we include cost/capacity recommendations from Redwood Optimize — helps pro-actively address billing concerns.

Maya Chen: Good call Tom. @Jared, can you add a one-slide cost optimization summary? (batching/quant profiles)

Jared Ortiz: Yep — short bullets + callouts.

OpsBot: Reminder — Dry-run calendar invite sent for Thu 10:30am PT. Attendees: Maya, Jared, Priya, Leah, Tom.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Last item: feedback capture — Leah, can you add 2-3 shadow Qs to the deck to capture customer sentiment (adoption, blockers, ROI)?

Leah Walker: Will do. Also add a slide with recommended next steps + owners.

Priya Rao: FYI I'm adding a one-liner about privacy/KMS questions the customer raised.

Jared Ortiz: Uploading draft slides now: /shared/nimbus-qbr/deck-v0.1.pptx

Maya Chen: Perfect. If no blockers, we'll lock the deck Wed EOD and send exec pre-read Thursday morning.

Leah Walker: +1. I'll post final action tracker when done.
